historical3seq.claim: CSPG4 positive median pattern coexists with adult-colon record above lowest EMC library; CHRNA6 nonuniform peak signal.
historical3seq.limit: These files exist locally; a bundle made only from core input-lock would omit the direct3SEQ record. The core replay does not rerun3SEQ. Include evidence-only tier if not promising separate3SEQ replay; include source/archive/scripts+all hash-only dependencies for that additional recipe.
historical3seq.scope_qualification: 4EMC library/STT records, not confirmed4independentpatients; cancer-selected square-root-compressed depth-scaled peaks, not TPM or foldchange.

minimization: No whole repository, GSE4303 original144MBsource, mutable .cache, entire HPA atlas or rawGTEx dataset is needed. Current locked array ZIP contains smaller legacyGSE4303 items already; retain archive bytes because lock requires them. Existing prior-art ZIP is convenient but not smallest in extracted form: strictly necessary PRAME context is exactXLSX+five-row extract+primarycitation/assay metadata; CHRNA6 citation is already in citation-anchors.json. Extracted-rights audit can avoid duplicating fullarticleXML already retained elsewhere.
runtime: Pinned installed Python/dependencies required separately; no offline Python/wheel distribution included by this source inventory.
review_and_render: Add actual frozen finalPDF/buildstamps/figure outputs and completed review receipts at final release freeze; this inventory does not invent paths for artifacts still being rendered or reviewed.
